package: K35-T1 local Chromium playback through HLS edge Worker

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped and removed
result.storage_fixture: loopback S3-compatible HTTP fixture with aws-chunked payload decoding; no external storage
result.browser: Playwright Chromium loaded the actual Next page and Vidstack/Hls.js player
result.edge_worker: actual workers/hls-edge/worker.mjs invoked by the browser route adapter
playback_assertions: master and variant playlists begin with #EXTM3U and return HTTP 200
initialization MP4 and nonempty fMP4 media segment return HTTP 200
media element reaches readyState > 1 and currentTime > 0.5 seconds

correction: Earlier local S3 fixture stored aws-chunked payload framing as object data. Prior K35 edge checks for contains(#EXTM3U) and nonempty segment did not prove valid HLS bytes. The corrected fixture decodes aws-chunked payloads; this browser acceptance supersedes the earlier limited content claim.
limitations: Local Chromium, local Worker invocation and S3-compatible fixture only; not deployed Cloudflare Worker or real R2.
Other browsers, mobile playback, permission revocation, complete role/state matrix, deployed configuration and independent review remain unverified.
K35-T1 and K01-T3 remain partial pending provider/deployed acceptance and independent review.
